newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Council to decide Yeltsin's heart surgeon.
newsitem.headline: Council to decide Yeltsin's heart surgeon.

text.p: A council of doctors will meet at the end of September to decide who will operate on President Boris Yeltsin's heart, top cardiologist Yevgeny Chazov told Interfax news agency on Monday.
Chazov, a world-renowned specialist who heads Moscow's Cardiological Centre which has already conducted tests on the president as an out-patient, gave no details.
Yeltsin said on Thursday he had decided to undergo surgery in order to return to "an active life".
He indicated it would be at Chazov's centre but there are at least four centres in the Moscow area where the operation could be done.
Experts say it is likely to be a by-pass operation, routine for those suffering from the ischaemic disease which put Yeltsin in hospital twice last year.
It was not clear from Chazov's words when the operation would take place once the council took its decision.
Chazov was quoted as saying on Friday that, if the president chose the Cardiological Centre, the operation would be performed by professor Renat Akchurin, head of the surgery department.
